# Brothers Hotshot Services

> Reliable, 24/7 dedicated hotshot trucking and expedited freight logistics across Western Canada, centrally headquartered in Red Deer, Alberta.

## Business Overview
Brothers Hotshot Services is a licensed, insured, and National Safety Code (NSC) compliant Canadian commercial carrier specializing in direct point-to-point hotshot delivery, heavy equipment hauling, urgent plant breakdown transport, and time-critical industrial logistics. We serve Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba, including Winnipeg.

## Core Capabilities & Equipment
- **Fleet Setup**: Commercial 1-Ton heavy-duty dually pickup trucks paired with 30-foot to 40-foot gooseneck flatbed trailers.
- **Loading & Capacity**: Full-width drive-on beavertail ramps, up to 16,500 lbs legal payload capacity.
- **Cargo Securement**: Grade-70 transport chains, ratchet load binders, heavy-duty 4-inch strap winches, corner protectors, and 18oz waterproof weather tarps.
- **Direct Transit**: Single-carrier dedicated routing with zero cross-docking, zero terminal transfers, and zero co-loading delays.

## Core Services
- **Hotshot Delivery**: Dedicated expedited freight transit for time-critical industrial goods.
- **Equipment & Machinery Hauling**: Safe transport for skid steers, mini-excavators, agricultural attachments, compressors, and generators.
- **Urgent & Emergency Breakdown Dispatch**: 24/7/365 rapid response for oilfield outages, pipeline repairs, and manufacturing plant shutdowns.
- **Parts & Industrial Components**: Direct delivery for hydraulic pumps, downhole tools, valves, flanges, and electric motors.
- **Material Transportation**: Hauling of structural steel, pipe bundles, tubing, fabrication skids, and crated goods.
- **Long-Distance Western Canada Corridors**: Seamless interprovincial transit along Highway 2 (QEII), Trans-Canada Highway 1, Yellowhead Highway 16, and Highway 63.
